priority.description:
@inheritDoc
The registrations will be ordered and evaluated based on priority.  When multiple graph APIs return a matching
{@link Vertex} the later evaluated API will have priority.  {@see Obj.mergeObj}
example
GraphTypeA has priority 1
GraphTypeB has priority 2
A matching Vertex will result in VertexFromGraphTypeB.mergeObj(VertexFromGraphTypeA)
